outcome: Histopathological changes (lymphocyte, eosinophil, histiocyte, fibroblast levels)
cohort: The study included 24 rats that underwent radical mastectomy and axillary lymph node dissection.
finding: Local PRP application significantly reduced seroma formation, and both PRP and cryopreserved HAM increased tissue healing and decreased the inflammatory process, but HAM application did not reduce seroma formation.
